queries.name: inbox_health
queries.sql:
SELECT
            l.id as "id!",
            l.macro_id as "macro_id!",
            l.fusionauth_user_id as "fusionauth_user_id!",
            l.email_address as "email_address!",
            l.provider as "provider!: _",
            l.is_sync_active as "is_sync_active!",
            l.is_primary as "is_primary!",
            l.needs_reauth as "needs_reauth!",
            l.mailbox_unavailable_at IS NOT NULL as "mailbox_unavailable!",
            l.mailbox_issue,
            l.mailbox_retry_at,
            l.last_sync_error_at,
            l.created_at as "created_at!",
            l.updated_at as "updated_at!",
            s.signature_on_replies_forwards as "signature_on_replies_forwards?",
            s.signature,
            s.read_receipts_enabled as "read_receipts_enabled?",
            CASE WHEN l.provider IN ('OUTLOOK', 'IMAP') THEN
                CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (
                    SELECT
                        1
                    FROM
                        email_sync_streams ss
                    WHERE
                        ss.link_id = l.id
                        AND ss.generation = l.sync_generation
                        AND ss.kind IN ('folder_catalog', 'mail_folder')) THEN
                    'Init'::email_backfill_job_status
                WHEN EXISTS (
                    SELECT
                        1
                    FROM
                        email_sync_streams ss
                    WHERE
                        ss.link_id = l.id
                        AND ss.generation = l.sync_generation
                        AND ss.kind IN ('folder_catalog', 'mail_folder')
                        AND NOT ss.initial_complete)
                    OR EXISTS (
                        SELECT
                            1
                        FROM
                            email_message_reconciliation mr
                        WHERE
                            mr.link_id = l.id
                            AND mr.generation = l.sync_generation
                            AND mr.is_import
                            AND mr.available_at <> 'infinity') THEN
                    'InProgress'::email_backfill_job_status
                ELSE
                    'Complete'::email_backfill_job_status
                END
            ELSE
                bj.status
            END as "latest_backfill_status?: _",
            c.sfs_photo_url as "photo_url?",
            CASE WHEN l.provider IN ('OUTLOOK', 'IMAP') THEN
                COALESCE(ms.granted_scopes, '{}')
            ELSE
                COALESCE(g.granted_scopes, '{}')
            END AS "provider_granted_scopes!",
            (
                CASE WHEN l.provider IN ('OUTLOOK', 'IMAP') THEN
                    ms.calendar_disabled_at
                ELSE
                    g.calendar_disabled_at
                END IS NOT NULL) AS "calendar_disabled!",
            EXISTS (
                SELECT
                    1
                FROM
                    calendar_accounts ca
                WHERE
                    ca.email_link_id = l.id) AS "has_calendar_data!"
        FROM (
            SELECT
                el.id,
                el.macro_id,
                el.fusionauth_user_id,
                el.email_address,
                el.provider,
                el.is_sync_active,
                el.is_primary,
                el.needs_reauth,
                el.last_sync_error_at,
                el.created_at,
                el.updated_at,
                el.sync_generation,
                el.grant_generation,
                el.mailbox_issue,
                el.mailbox_retry_at,
                el.mailbox_unavailable_at
            FROM
                email_links el
            WHERE
                el.macro_id = $1
            UNION
            SELECT
                el.id,
                el.macro_id,
                el.fusionauth_user_id,
                el.email_address,
                el.provider,
                el.is_sync_active,
                el.is_primary,
                el.needs_reauth,
                el.last_sync_error_at,
                el.created_at,
                el.updated_at,
                el.sync_generation,
                el.grant_generation,
                el.mailbox_issue,
                el.mailbox_retry_at,
                el.mailbox_unavailable_at
            FROM
                email_links el
                JOIN macro_user_links mul ON el.id = mul.link_id
            WHERE
                mul.primary_macro_id = $1) l
            LEFT JOIN email_link_google_scopes g ON g.link_id = l.id
            LEFT JOIN email_link_microsoft_scopes ms ON ms.link_id = l.id
                AND ms.grant_generation = l.grant_generation
            LEFT JOIN email_settings s ON s.link_id = l.id
            LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
                SELECT
                    status
                FROM
                    email_backfill_jobs
                WHERE
                    link_id = l.id
                ORDER BY
                    created_at DESC
                LIMIT 1) bj ON true
            LEFT JOIN email_contacts c ON c.link_id = l.id
                AND LOWER(c.email_address) = LOWER(l.email_address)
            ORDER BY
                l.created_at DESC

queries.name: manual_reconnect
queries.sql:
INSERT INTO imap_accounts (link_id, user_id, sync_generation, grant_generation, credential_ciphertext, state)
            SELECT
                $1,
                $2,
                $3,
                $4,
                $5,
                $6
            WHERE
                EXISTS (
                    SELECT
                        1
                    FROM
                        email_links
                    WHERE
                        id = $1
                        AND macro_id = $2
                        AND provider = 'IMAP')
            ON CONFLICT (link_id)
                DO UPDATE SET
                    sync_generation = EXCLUDED.sync_generation,
                    grant_generation = EXCLUDED.grant_generation,
                    credential_ciphertext = EXCLUDED.credential_ciphertext,
                    state = jsonb_set(
                        imap_accounts.state - 'mailbox_issue' - 'sync_retry_at' - 'sync_size_failures',
                        '{needs_reauth}',
                        'false'::jsonb),
                    lease_id = NULL,
                    lease_until = NULL,
                    revision = imap_accounts.revision + 1,
                    folder_preferences_revision = imap_accounts.folder_preferences_revision + 1
                WHERE
                    imap_accounts.user_id = EXCLUDED.user_id
                    AND imap_accounts.sync_generation <= EXCLUDED.sync_generation
                    AND imap_accounts.grant_generation <= EXCLUDED.grant_generation
                    AND (imap_accounts.sync_generation < EXCLUDED.sync_generation
                        OR imap_accounts.grant_generation < EXCLUDED.grant_generation)

Plan.Conflict Filter: ((imap_accounts.user_id = excluded.user_id) AND (imap_accounts.sync_generation <= excluded.sync_generation) AND (imap_accounts.grant_generation <= excluded.grant_generation) AND ((imap_accounts.sync_generation < excluded.sync_generation) OR (imap_accounts.grant_generation < excluded.grant_generation)))

queries.name: folder_preference_retry_clear
queries.sql:
WITH changed AS (
                UPDATE
                    imap_accounts
                SET
                    folder_preferences_revision = folder_preferences_revision + 1,
                    revision = revision + 1,
                    folder_role_overrides = $5,
                    excluded_folder_ids = $6,
                    watched_folder_ids = $7,
                    state = imap_accounts.state - 'sync_retry_at',
                    updated_at = now()
                FROM
                    email_links l
                WHERE
                    imap_accounts.link_id = $1
                    AND imap_accounts.sync_generation = $2
                    AND imap_accounts.grant_generation = $3
                    AND folder_preferences_revision = $4
                    AND l.id = imap_accounts.link_id
                    AND l.macro_id = imap_accounts.user_id
                    AND l.provider = 'IMAP'
                    AND l.is_sync_active
                    AND l.disconnect_requested_at IS NULL
                    AND l.deleting_at IS NULL
                    AND l.sync_generation = imap_accounts.sync_generation
                    AND l.grant_generation = imap_accounts.grant_generation
                RETURNING
                    imap_accounts.link_id,
                    folder_preferences_revision
            )
            SELECT
                c.folder_preferences_revision AS "revision!"
            FROM
                changed c
                CROSS JOIN LATERAL pg_notify('imap_config_changed', c.link_id::text)

(is_sync_active AND (disconnect_requested_at IS NULL) AND (deleting_at IS NULL) AND (sync_generation = $2) AND (grant_generation = $3) AND (provider = 'IMAP'::email_user_provider_enum))
